text: dsh-webchat 是一个 DSH 桌面插件，在侧边栏添加 Chat 入口，并把 chat.deepseek.com 官方页面显示在窗口中栏。它使用桌面端浏览器访客承载网页，在切换面板时保留访客；登录状态通过页面存储和主进程可用时的 Cookie 快照恢复。还可刷新页面、把网页弹出的外链交给系统默认浏览器。需要 DeepSeek 账户及支持原生访客的 DSH 桌面端；普通 Web 环境提供独立窗口打开方式。

dsh-webchat adds a Chat sidebar entry for chat.deepseek.com in DSH Desktop. It keeps the browser guest alive across panel changes, saves page storage and available cookies for login continuity, supports refresh shortcuts, and opens popup links in the system browser. Requires a DeepSeek account.

dsh-webchat 的功能「侧边栏聊天页」：在侧边栏注册 Chat 入口，并在主面板显示官方 DeepSeek 网页。桌面端通过原生浏览器访客加载页面。
dsh-webchat 的功能「保持网页会话」：在页面和主进程之间保存、恢复站点存储与可用的 Cookie，使登录状态可跨应用重启延续。
dsh-webchat 的功能「后台保留访客」：切换到其他面板时隐藏常驻网页元素，返回时重新定位显示，避免卸载访客。
dsh-webchat 的功能「刷新聊天网页」：面板显示时注册 F5 与 Ctrl/Cmd+R 快捷键，用于刷新网页而不重载外层应用。
dsh-webchat 的功能「外链与窗口降级」：将网页弹出的 HTTP(S) 链接交给系统浏览器；没有原生访客桥接时可请求主进程打开网页窗口。
dsh-webchat 使用前须知：网页内容来自 chat.deepseek.com，登录和聊天需要使用该站点账户；插件没有单独的模型 API Key 配置项。
dsh-webchat 使用前须知：嵌入式访客依赖 DSH 桌面端桥接；没有桥接的 Web 环境会显示独立窗口打开选项。

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · 介绍：在 [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 里打开 [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com) 官方网页版：点侧边栏「Chat」，真实页面就渲染在 **DSH 窗口的中栏**里，和「自动化任务」那类整页视图一样。

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

或直接从仓库安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

安装后**重启桌面端**。

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · 使用：- 再点一次入口收起面板；切换去别的面板（插件、自动化任务、会话……）时访客只是被隐藏、从不被卸载，所以切回来不会重新加载、也不会掉登录。
- 回复里的外链（引用、来源这类会弹新窗口的链接）现在交给**系统默认浏览器**打开——之前点了毫无反应。
- 桌面端给浏览器访客的分区是**进程内**的（每次运行随机命名），所以登录态由本插件自己保存：页面的 localStorage 与页面自己的 cookie 由页面侧搬运，分区 cookie（**含 HttpOnly**）在宿主能拿到 Electron 时一并搬运。宿主拿不到 Electron 时，前两条仍然生效。
- **想退出登录**：先完全退出 DSH，再删除登录快照。默认在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-webchat\session.json`；设置了 `DSH_HOME` 环境变量时跟随它：`<DSH_HOME>\dsh-webchat\session.json`（旧快照只迁移一次，旧文件保留供备份，可手动删除；请保留不含登录信息的 `session.migrated` 标记，防止旧登录再次迁入）。
@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · 使用：在 Chat 面板中按 **F5 或 Ctrl+R**（macOS 为 **⌘R**）刷新官方页面，即可更新其他设备新增的会话；无需重启应用，也没有额外的刷新按钮。快捷键可在宿主的快捷键设置中调整。

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · 登录兼容性：- 用户代理只移除 `Electron/<版本>` token、其余原样保留：既躲开站点对 "electron" 字样的「使用环境异常」弹窗，又不制造版本指纹失配（后者曾加重 WAF 验证循环与 Google 登录异常）。
- 登录恢复完成前暂停所有自动保存，恢复失败保留原有快照；仅在官方聊天网站读写页面登录信息，授权网站的 cookie 不进入快照。
- 自动保存时排除 AWS WAF 验证 cookie 和存储；恢复旧快照时跳过 WAF 存储。手动导入的 cookie 仍按原样恢复，但之后不会自动保存其中的 WAF cookie。
- DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的部分环境无法提供 Electron cookie 接口：此时仍通过页面存储恢复登录，但无法保存或恢复 HttpOnly cookie。诊断接口 `/api/dsh-webchat/state` 的 `session.electron` 会报告可用性。
- 上述修复不能保证内嵌浏览器一定能通过站点验证；真实登录、Google 授权及重启恢复仍取决于宿主与站点行为。

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · Introduction：Opens the official [chat.deepseek.com](https://chat.deepseek.com) web app inside [DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): click "Chat" in the sidebar and the real page renders in the **center column of the DSH window**, like any other full-page view.

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

Or straight from this repository:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jaychang1989/dsh-webchat
```

**Restart the desktop app after installing.**

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · Use：1. Click "Chat" in the sidebar — the page loads in the center column; there is no second click.
2. Sign in to DeepSeek once — **restarts will not ask again**.

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · Use：- Clicking again collapses the panel. Switching to another panel (Plugins, Automation Tasks, a session …) only hides the guest, never unmounts it, so coming back neither reloads the page nor drops the session.
- External reply links (citations and sources that would open a new window) now open in the **system default browser** — before, clicking them did nothing.
- The shell hands every browser guest a **process-lifetime** partition (a fresh random name per run), so this plugin carries the session itself: the page's localStorage and its own cookies travel through the page, and the partition's cookies (**HttpOnly included**) travel through the host half wherever Electron is reachable. Without Electron, the first two still work.
- **To sign out**: fully quit DSH, then delete the snapshot file. It lives at `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-webchat\session.json` by default, or `<DSH_HOME>\dsh-webchat\session.json` when `DSH_HOME` is set. Legacy credentials are migrated once and the old file is retained for backup; it can be removed manually. Keep the credential-free `session.migrated` marker to prevent the old login from being imported again.

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · Use：Press **F5 or Ctrl+R** (**⌘R** on macOS) while Chat is selected to refresh the official page and fetch conversations created on another device. No extra refresh button or app restart is needed. The bindings can be customized in the shell shortcut settings.

@jaychang1989/dsh-webchat README · Login compatibility：- The user agent only drops the `Electron/<version>` token; everything else passes through byte-for-byte. This dodges the site's literal "electron" substring check (the 使用环境异常 dialog) without the version-fingerprint mismatch that once worsened WAF challenges and Google sign-in.
- All automatic saves wait for login restoration and its reload to finish. Failed restoration preserves the previous snapshot. Page credentials are only accessed on the official chat origin, and OAuth-site cookies are excluded.
- Automatic snapshots exclude AWS WAF cookies and storage. Old WAF storage is skipped during restore. Explicitly imported cookies are still restored as supplied, but WAF cookies are not automatically saved afterwards.
- Some DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 environments expose no Electron cookie API. Page storage can still carry the login, but HttpOnly cookies cannot be saved or restored there. `/api/dsh-webchat/state` reports availability through `session.electron`.
- These fixes do not guarantee that an embedded browser passes site challenges. Real sign-in, Google authorization and restart survival still depend on the host and site.
